build_CLIP_loss_module: build a CLIPLoss module to compute contrastive image-text loss with distributed GPU gathering
create_SSL_CLIP_loss: create an SSLCLIPLoss module to compute contrastive loss with pseudo labels and ground truth indicators
run_caption_loss: run a CaptionLoss module to compute token-level cross-entropy loss for caption generation
test_max_margin_ranking_loss: test the MaxMarginRankingLoss class to compute margin-based ranking loss on image-text similarity matrices
review_adaptive_max_margin_ranking_loss: review the AdaptiveMaxMarginRankingLoss class to compute weighted margin ranking loss with per-sample importance weights
